  "pros": [
    "Consolidated multi-channel communication (email, SMS, WhatsApp) in one platform.",
    "Streamlined setup and authentication processes for transactional emails.",
    "Helpful customer support in resolving initial account verification issues."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Initial account suspension for review can be an unexpected hurdle.",
    "Data import/export can be cumbersome, especially with custom fields.",
    "Campaigns listing page sometimes fails to load, hindering workflow."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The IT Operations Coordinator found Brevo to be a capable platform for managing multi-channel communications, appreciating its ability to consolidate various marketing tools. While the initial account verification process presented a minor hurdle, the support team was responsive in resolving it. They generally found the setup for transactional emails straightforward, but noted some frustrations with data handling and occasional performance issues with the campaigns listing."
